## Positron: Get the latest updates {.no-invert-dark-mode background-image="assets/git-pull-positron.png" background-size="100%" background-position="center 300px"}

* Open git panel, git fetch, then sync changes
* Or **Git: Pull** in Command Palette

## Rstudio: Get the latest updates {.no-invert-dark-mode background-image="assets/git-pull-rstudio.png" background-size="100%" background-position="center 300px"}

* Open Git panel
* Click **⬇ Pull**

## Install All The Things {.center}

Open the `llms` project and...

### ![](../assets/icons/r-color.svg){height="1em" alt="R" style="vertical-align: bottom"}

```r
install.packages("pak") # if you don't have it yet

pak::local_install_deps()
```

### ![](../assets/icons/python-icon-color.svg){height="1em" alt="" style="vertical-align: bottom"} Python {style="margin-top: 1em"}

```python
uv sync -p 3.14
```
